value: THE RE-RANKED PROMOTION BACKLOG (run 50, measured at 1370dce50). The flipped-verdict evidence class was recomputed from scratch and reproduces claim.law.T19_savedregs-default-read-reports-the-postprocessor-not-the-compiler-on-a-pinned-function.20260903.v1 exactly: 156 of 156 pins decode in both modes, 84 FLIP (default ASSIGNMENT MATCHES, --raw contradicts), none flips the other way. Ranking those 84 by the promotion queue's raw differing-word count ALONE puts DEAD work first, and that is the finding the next promotion lane needs before it picks a target. Classifying each flip by the SHAPE of its role mismatch: 8 of the 84 are PURELY the live-zero copy-vs-remat family (target `addi rD,rS,0` where rS is a dominating `li rS,0`, ours `li rD,0`), and they occupy FOUR of the five smallest-word rows in the whole queue -- game/audio/audio::AudioUnloadPart (1 word), ::AudioBankLoadName (1), ::AudioBankQueueName (1) and game/world/newcam::fn_8006E654 (1), then game/enemy/critter::ProcessCritter (3), game/world/newcam::fn_8006F16C (3), game/sys/memcard::MemCardCreateGaunt (5) and game/audio/dcs::dcsSampleAllocUpload (7). Every one of those is already closed as source-unreachable by claim.law.live-zero-copy-vs-remat-is-allocator-not-source.20260831.v1, which records fourteen dead source axes, a case where MWCC built the derived induction variable itself with no source variable to spell and still chose remat, and bidirectional evidence from dcsdrv.c::dcsHandleRequest where the SAME mechanism runs the opposite way. So the flip is real on all eight and supplies NO new lever on any of them: the pin's own mechanism prose was already derived from the raw body, not from the postprocessed table. THE USABLE HEAD OF THE QUEUE, after dropping that family, is: game/game/combat::cam_orient_to_80029E8C (2 words, capped again this run -- see attempt.PR_camorient-the-corpus-controls-own-pragma-pair-is-measured-dead-on-this-function.20260903.v1), game/ui/btext::FontInit (2 words, but wf_word_diff reads MNEMONIC DIVERGENCE 1 / OPCODE 1, so it is SCHEDULE-REORDER and no copy_register_fields rule reaches it; hard-capped 2026-08-29 with a full flagsweep), game/game/player::do_heal_players (5, 0 probed of 3 records), game/sys/memcard::add_vmu_file (5, no provenance citation), game/world/btricol::BTriLineCol (5), game/enemy/critter::CritterLineNodeColSub (6, capped this run with a named class-order mechanism), game/world/tower::SumnerDoSpeech (7, a clean two-web swap of `mr. r3` against `mr r3`), then game/enemy/enemy::move_logic30/02/04/14 (8/16/16/16), which share ONE shape across four pins -- r31 holds `mr r4` in the target and `mr r3` in ours -- and are the largest single-mechanism payoff left in the flip set. Those 24 are simultaneously the best promotion candidates (nobody has written down a dead axis on them) and the rules that most owe the Mandatory-policy source-first pass.
